answer_1.quote: This paper is the first to study how to rewrite inappropriate arguments automatically.
answer_1.outputs: Rewritten arguments that are more appropriate while preserving semantic similarity.

answer_2.quote: We calculate the following performance values: • App. Percentage of arguments for which an approach has flipped the prediction from inappropriate to appropriate; • Sim. Semantic similarity of a rewrite to the input argument in terms of BERTScore; • NES. Normalized word-wise edit similarity; • PPL. Fluency in terms of perplexity; • GM. Geometric mean of App., Sim. and 1/PPL

answer_4.quote: We again hire native English speakers on Upwork.com (7 female and 8 male) to evaluate the rewrites in absolute and relative terms
answer_4.guideline: We instructed annotators with background information about appropriateness and scored each rewrite regarding three considered quality metrics: App. Appropriateness of the topic discussion in terms of style and content; Sim. Meaning preservation of the original arguments; Flu. Fluency and adherence to grammar conventions.
